source: GOV.UK MHCLG Revenue Outturn (2024/25), DOGE forensic analysis, spending data analysis, budgets_summary.json

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Preventative highways maintenance vs reactive repair
savings_opportunities.evidence: Every £1 not spent on preventative maintenance costs £4-8 in reactive repairs (HMEP 2023). Surface dressing at £3-5/m² is 5-10x cheaper than full reconstruction at £30-50/m². Risk-based asset management approach prioritises investment on highest-traffic routes.
savings_opportunities.risk: Medium — requires sustained capital investment to realise revenue savings

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Waste disposal contract re-procurement and recycling improvement
savings_opportunities.evidence: Competitive re-tendering of waste disposal. Improving recycling rates diverts tonnage from expensive residual treatment (£100-120/t residual vs £30-50/t recycled). Food waste separate collection (mandatory from March 2026 — Environment Act 2021) can divert 30% of residual.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: LED street lighting conversion and smart dimming
savings_opportunities.evidence: LED conversion delivers 50-70% energy savings over sodium. Dimming profiles (midnight-5am) and part-night operation offer further 10-15%. Central Management Systems (CMS) enable remote fault detection, reducing patrol costs. Salix finance available at 0% interest.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Highways permit scheme and lane rental income (NRSWA s171)
savings_opportunities.evidence: Permit schemes for utility road openings generate net income after admin costs. Lane rental schemes (TMA 2004 s73A) recover cost of congestion from utility works — £5-15K per day in high-traffic areas. Over-run charges incentivise faster completion.
savings_opportunities.risk: Low — established legal framework, DfT encourages adoption

key_contracts.note: Top department: Adult Social Care & Prevention

commercialisation.lever: Fleet management and specialist vehicle hire
commercialisation.evidence: Shared fleet services with partner organisations (fire, police, NHS). EV charging on council land (10-15% ROI). Vehicle maintenance traded to parish councils. Annual MOT testing income from public facility.

commercialisation.lever: Commercial waste collection and green waste premium
commercialisation.evidence: Trade waste collection to SMEs (£30-80/month per business). Premium garden waste subscriptions (£40-60/yr, 30-40% take-up). Bulky waste charging (£25-40 per collection). Annual income typically £500K-2M for county/unitary scale.
Roundabout sponsorship (£3-10K/yr), lamp post banners, digital advertising on council land. Revenue share with specialist operators. Bus shelter advertising concessions. Car park naming rights.

directorates.name: Communities & Culture

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Library service transformation and community partnership model
savings_opportunities.evidence: Community-managed or shared library models reduce direct costs 15-30% while maintaining statutory access (Public Libraries and Museums Act 1964). Volunteer-supported models in 40+ authorities. Self-service technology (RFID) reduces staffing needs 25-35%.
savings_opportunities.risk: Medium — statutory duty requires needs assessment and consultation

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Leisure trust model and VAT efficiency
savings_opportunities.evidence: Leisure trust models deliver 20% VAT saving on admissions income (HMRC NPDO exemption). Annual saving of £80-150K per wet-and-dry centre. Trust model also unlocks NNDR charity relief (80% mandatory + 20% discretionary). HMRC Midlothian ruling (2024) clarified agency model.
savings_opportunities.risk: Low — well-established model, TUPE transfer required

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Registration service and archives digitalisation
savings_opportunities.evidence: Digital access to archives reduces physical storage costs (£50-100/m²/yr). Online registration booking reduces counter staff time 30%. Birth/death certificate digitisation saves per-transaction costs. Genealogy subscription income from digitised records.

commercialisation.lever: Events, venue hire and filming location income
commercialisation.evidence: Council-owned buildings, parks and spaces for weddings (£2-10K/booking), conferences (£500-2K/day), filming (£500-5,000/day). Location filming fees increasingly significant (£15M+ spent in English regions 2023). Wedding venue licensing for heritage buildings.
NHS services, post office counters, café operations co-located in libraries. Rental income + footfall increase. Coffee franchise concessions £10-30K/yr per site. Warm spaces programme funding.

Gift shops, guided tours, educational workshops, schools programme. Heritage sites: £3-8 admission. Events programme: Christmas markets (£50-200K net), food festivals, craft fairs. Tourism BID partnerships for destination marketing.

waste_flags: Cultural and related services growth: +36.6% year-on-year (13,824,000 vs 10,119,000) — review demand drivers

directorates.name: Place Services

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Planning fee income maximisation and pre-application charging
savings_opportunities.evidence: Enhanced pre-application advice (£500-5K per major app), Planning Performance Agreements (£10-50K). National 25% fee increase (Dec 2023) partially offsets cost pressures. Permitted development monitoring fees. Community Infrastructure Levy administration fee (5% of CIL receipts).
savings_opportunities.risk: Low — income already budgeted, scope for growth

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Homelessness prevention to reduce temporary accommodation costs
savings_opportunities.evidence: Each family in temporary accommodation costs £20-40K/yr (nightly rate + admin). Prevention programmes (Homelessness Reduction Act 2017 duty) show 50-60% success rate. Rapid Rehousing Pathway: £5K per prevented case vs £25K+ for B&B placement. Housing First model for complex needs (80% tenancy sustainment).
savings_opportunities.risk: Medium — demand-driven, private rental market constraints

savings_opportunities.opportunity: HMO licensing income expansion and enforcement
savings_opportunities.evidence: Mandatory and additional HMO licensing generates income from fees (£500-1,000 per licence, 5-year renewal). Selective licensing for whole areas (Housing Act 2004 Part 3). Enforcement action recovers costs + Civil Penalty Notices up to £30K per offence (alternative to prosecution).

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Building control market share recovery
savings_opportunities.evidence: Approved Inspector market share now ~60% nationally. Council building control competes on speed, local knowledge, and completion certificate reliability. Full cost recovery through fees (Building Act 1984). Building Safety Act 2022 Higher Risk Buildings must use council BC — growth opportunity.

commercialisation.lever: Strategic land and property disposal programme
commercialisation.evidence: Strategic disposal of surplus land/property holdings for capital receipts. Community asset transfers where appropriate. One Public Estate partnerships. Revenue from Right to Buy receipts (retained 40%). Land assembly for joint ventures with housing associations.

Local housing companies build/acquire properties for market and affordable rent. Net revenue from rents after financing costs. 30+ councils now operate housing companies. Typical 3-5% yield on investment. Also reduces temporary accommodation costs through supply.

Planning and development services growth: +83.7% year-on-year (3,445,000 vs 1,875,000) — review demand drivers

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Procurement consolidation and category management
savings_opportunities.evidence: Category management, framework consolidation, and supplier rationalisation. CIPFA recommends 3-5% procurement savings target on addressable spend. National Procurement Strategy 2024 mandates social value weighting. E-procurement systems reduce processing costs £15-30 per transaction.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Digital transformation and channel shift
savings_opportunities.evidence: Channel shift to digital self-service reduces transaction costs: phone call £5-7, face-to-face £8-14, web self-service £0.10-0.30. RPA for high-volume processing (council tax changes, benefits assessment). AI chatbot for first-line enquiries (25-40% deflection rate). GDS design standards.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: PWLB debt repayment and treasury management optimisation
savings_opportunities.evidence: Opportunistic early repayment of high-rate PWLB loans when cash flow permits. Each £1M early repayment of 4%+ loans saves £30-50K/yr in interest. Internal borrowing from cash balances (currently earning 4-5% vs paying 4-6% on PWLB). CIPFA TM Code compliance.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Agency and interim staff spend reduction
savings_opportunities.evidence: Replace long-term agency workers (12+ months) with permanent or fixed-term contracts. Agency markup typically 15-30% over direct employment cost. LGA workforce survey 2024: average 7.5% agency spend. Council-operated agency (Comensura-type) reduces margin leakage.
savings_opportunities.risk: Low — if recruitment market allows, improves institutional knowledge

savings_opportunities.opportunity: Insurance mutual membership and self-insurance
savings_opportunities.evidence: Local authority mutual models (e.g., LAML) vs commercial insurers save 5-15% on premiums. Higher excess/deductible with risk management reserve. Annual premium saving £100-500K depending on authority size. Property consolidation reduces insured portfolio.
savings_opportunities.risk: Medium — requires risk appetite and reserve allocation

savings_opportunities.opportunity: DOGE finding: Suppliers with Current Red Flags
savings_opportunities.evidence: 6 current suppliers have Companies House compliance issues (historical payments were made before breaches started) Flagged value: £1.8M.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: DOGE finding: Likely Duplicate Payments
savings_opportunities.evidence: 352 high-confidence duplicate groups with same supplier, amount, date and reference (3+ copies) (after filtering 8832 CSV republication artifacts) Flagged value: £778.4K.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: DOGE finding: Possible Duplicate Payments
savings_opportunities.evidence: 585 medium-confidence groups (same supplier/amount/date, different references) Flagged value: £2.0M.

savings_opportunities.opportunity: DOGE finding: Suspected Split Payments
savings_opportunities.evidence: 146 instances of 3+ payments just below approval thresholds in the same week Flagged value: £30.5M.

savings_opportunities.evidence: 1598 exact round-number payments over £5,000 — may indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts Flagged value: £64.3M.

Selling council expertise in areas of strength (trading standards, building control, elections admin, data analytics) to other authorities. Knowledge transfer partnerships. Secondment income from partner organisations.
